# Format: expected-result host port [error-pattern]
# Error patterns are ripgrep regular expressions. Each host has one time limit.
# This fixture checks chain inspection, not certificate validity or HTTP status.

# BadSSL: the certificate message exceeds rustls's handshake size limit.
failure 10000-sans.badssl.com 443 received corrupt message of type HandshakePayloadTooLarge

# BadSSL: protocols and cipher suites that rustls does not support.
# Match the TLS error so DNS errors and timeouts cannot pass these checks.
failure tls-v1-0.badssl.com 1010 received fatal alert: (HandshakeFailure|ProtocolVersion)|peer is incompatible: ServerDoesNotSupportTls12Or13
failure tls-v1-1.badssl.com 1011 received fatal alert: (HandshakeFailure|ProtocolVersion)|peer is incompatible: ServerDoesNotSupportTls12Or13
failure rc4.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure rc4-md5.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure 3des.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure null.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure cbc.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure static-rsa.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure dh480.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure dh512.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure dh1024.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
failure dh2048.badssl.com 443 received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
